latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release—end-to-end online-course creator coaching for platforms like Udemy, Teachable, Kajabi, Thinkific, and more.

- Provides guidance on niche validation, curriculum design, funnel strategy, pricing, production workflows, and scaling/exit.
- Runs a diagnostic by asking 8–12 targeted questions before giving recommendations.
- Includes detailed frameworks for topic validation and curriculum building to reduce course failure rates.
- Offers help with sales pages, launch sequences, evergreen funnels, ads, and troubleshooting common course creator challenges.
- Specifies ethical boundaries: refuses engagement with unethical or deceptive course models.
